subject: Red Dragon
text: The Red Dragon uses a Blaze attack comparable to Fir3, which can be mitigated with Afir.

evidence.quote: He's not too terribly hard, but does use a Blaze attack, and after watching this in action, I believe that it is on par at least damage wise as Fir3. You should make sure you are fully healed before entering this battle. It is a fairly short fight, but if you want to avoid major damage you should use Afir

subject: Kary
text: Casting Afir defends against Kary's Fir2 attacks.

evidence.quote: Have your White Wizard or even a Knight, cast Afir. This should help you defend against her Fir2 attacks.

subject: Kary
text: Having the White Wizard use Inv2 or the White Shirt reduces damage from Kary's attacks.

evidence.quote: You should also have your White Wizard use Inv2 or the White Shirt for the same affect. This will help reduce damage done to you by the wild amounts of hits which Kary can get.
